title: Meadowbound
tagline: A cozy 2D action platform adventure about restoring the Great Sunburst Tree
description: Embark on an enchanting woodland adventure with Pip, a spirited forest sprite, across 5 handcrafted biomes. Dash across verdant meadows, leap through foggy ancient woods, navigate bioluminescent caverns, ride gusting mountain updrafts, and restore the 25 lost Sun Berries to revive the Great Sunburst Tree and soothe the slumbering Bramblethorn Golem.
howToPlay:
Desktop Controls:
- [A] / [D] or [Arrow Keys]: Move Left / Right
- [Space] / [W] / [Up Arrow]: Variable-height Jump
- [Shift] / [J] / [X]: Mid-air Meadow Dash (1 per jump, reset on landing or stomping)
- [E] / [Enter]: Talk to NPCs, read lore medallions & attune Waystones
- [Esc] / [P]: Pause / Resume Game
- Stomp Enemies: Land on enemies from above to bounce skyward (+320px/s) and refresh Meadow Dash.

Mobile Controls:
- Virtual D-Pad for responsive running & crouching
- Dedicated on-screen touch buttons for Jump (🕊️), Meadow Dash (🍃), and Talk / Interact (💬)
- On-screen Audio Mute toggle button (🔊 / 🔇) in the top-right HUD.
features: 5 Diverse Handcrafted Biomes (Sunny Meadowlands, Whispering Woods, Bioluminescent Caverns, Highland Cliffs, Elder Canopy)
Tight & Snappy Kinematics with Coyote Time (100ms), Jump Buffering (120ms), and 1x Mid-air Meadow Dash
Dynamic Enemy Archetypes (Acorn Walker, Spore Hopper, Glow Bat, Bramble Charger) & 3-Phase Bramblethorn Golem Boss Encounter
25 Collectible Sun Berries, 50 Golden Acorns, and 5 Secret Lore Medallions with NPC narrative integration
Procedural Web Audio Synthesizer with custom biome chiptune arpeggios, melodic NPC chirps, and dynamic sound effects
On-screen Audio Mute control and automated tab visibility pause/resume lifecycle handling
Persistent Save System (meadowbound_save_v1) with Playgama Cloud Storage sync and local fallback
Zero external broken CDN dependencies, tracking scripts, or analytics - 100% self-contained
